note: Kasikornbank's sales sheet for K eSavings (conditions as announced effective 25 April 2026): an account maintenance fee of 20 baht a month falls only on an account inactive for more than a year with under 2,000 baht in it, which an account in use never is; transaction fees across clearing zones aren't modelled.

sources.title: Kasikornbank, Sales Sheet: K eSavings
sources.said: Account maintenance fee Account maintenance fee of 20 Baht/month will be charged if account is inactive for more than one year and the account balance is less than 2,000 Baht.
